claimText: 5G towers have been proven to cause COVID-19 by WHO

brave.title: WHO: 5G mobile networks do NOT spread COVID-19
brave.description: Viruses cannot travel on radio waves/mobile networks. COVID-19 is spreading in many countries that do not have 5G mobile networks.

brave.title: Full Fact: There is no link between 5G and coronavirus
brave.description: The conspiracy theory that 5G towers cause or spread COVID-19 has been debunked by scientists, telecoms regulators, and the WHO. There is no evidence of any link.

brave.title: BBC Reality Check: The 5G coronavirus conspiracy theory
brave.description: The claim that 5G causes COVID-19 has no scientific basis. COVID-19 is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, which spreads through respiratory droplets.

brave.title: PolitiFact: No, 5G technology does not cause COVID-19
brave.description: There is no scientific evidence that 5G networks cause, spread, or worsen COVID-19. This conspiracy theory has been repeatedly debunked.

brave.title: ICNIRP: 5G and health — what does the science say?
brave.description: The International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection has reviewed 5G technology and found no evidence it poses health risks when guidelines are followed.
